messages:
maria: Hey team — launching next week: we need a compact ‘sticker sheet’ asset pack for the micro-launch playbook. Think small badges/icons for slides, social cards, webinar footers, and quick A/B talk-track stickers. Core pillars: latency, cost, reliability, deploy-anywhere. Can design take this on?

kevin: @maria yep we can. Do you have a prioritized list of badges and sizes? also: any copy variants per badge?

maria: Priorities: 1) latency (spark icon) 2) cost (coin + downward arrow) 3) reliability (shield) 4) deploy-anywhere (map/pin). Also need two micro-badges: “Redwood Verified” and “SLA-ready”. Copy variants: short label (one word) + 2-word explainer for slide captions.

tess: Brand note — use primary brand palette only, no alternate typefaces. Stickers must pass contrast for accessibility (WCAG AA). No full-bleed gradients; subtle shadows ok. Guideline: https://redwood.in/brand-guidelines (see sticker section).

kevin: Cool. For outputs, what file formats and resolution? SVG + PNG @2x? Transparent bg?

nora: Please include: SVG, PNG 600x600, PNG 300x300, and a 1200×300 horizontal banner slice for slide footers. All with transparent backgrounds where appropriate. Also a 32px favicon-sized export for in-product use.

jordan: For social we’ll want 3 color treatments (brand primary, dark-on-light, white-on-dark) to test contrast in ads. Also would like 2 CTA badge overlays: "Try on Hosted API" and "Bring your Private", short labels only.

kevin: Got it. Planning: sketch comps today, initial vector badges tomorrow AM, full exports by Thursday EOD. Any legal/compliance checks needed?

tess: I’ll review for brand compliance once comps are up. Legal team only needs to sign off on the "Redwood Verified" mark — tag me and I’ll route.

maria: Timing is tight — webinar is Fri (launch). If Thursday EOD export works, we can stage slides + social the same evening.

kevin: Uploading Figma starter file now and adding a production checklist. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/rl-sticker-sheet (figma-bot will post updates).

figma-bot: Figma file created by kevin: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/rl-sticker-sheet — components: badge-base, icon-sprites, text-variants.

kevin: Quick spec block for ops: ```
- Badge master artboard: 1200x1200 px
- Square exports: 600x600 and 300x300 (PNG @2x), 150x150 (PNG @1x)
- Banner slice: 1200x300 px (PNG + JPG)
- Inline favicons: 32x32 px (PNG)
- Vectors: export full SVG set, single-path optimized
- Naming: badge_<pillar>_<treatment>_<size>.ext
```

jordan: Can we add two alt-tag strings per badge (for email/social alt text)? Short + descriptive. Example: "Latency — sub-ms serving" and "Latency — low per-token cost".

maria: Yes — give 2 alt-tag options for each: one focused on performance, one on business benefit.

kevin: Will do. I’ll also add a single-slide PNG preview pack (3-up: badge, caption variant A, caption variant B) so growth can A/B copy quickly. ETA Thursday noon for comps, full pack Thu EOD.

nora: Noting file handoff: export folder -> GDrive -> marketing/launch-assets/micro-sticker-pack/ with a manifest.csv listing filenames and alt-text. I’ll patrol uploads and confirm once made.

maria: Perfect. @kevin please ping when comps are up so tess/legal can review and we can finalize webinar slides. :thumbsup: :paintbrush:
